title: Civil maintenance to the Lighthouse, allied buildings and compound wall at Vembar Lighthouse.
summary: E-tender for civil maintenance of the lighthouse tower, allied buildings and compound wall at Vembar Lighthouse, Tuticorin district, Tamil Nadu, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, 5/20 Jaffer Syrang Street, Chennai

sites.name: Vembar Lighthouse, Tuticorin district, Tamilnadu
sites.work: Civil maintenance of lighthouse, allied buildings and compound wall

scope.item: Civil maintenance to the Lighthouse, allied buildings and compound wall

money.notes: Estimated cost includes 18% GST. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai, valid three months from technical bid opening; tender fee (non-refundable) by DD. Originals due by 22.09.2022 15:00.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Government/PSU/autonomous bodies

Similar works completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two each >= 50%, or one >= 80%; value updated at 7% simple per annum; certificates from officers below Executive Engineer not considered
Similar works: repairs and civil maintenance of building or construction of any building/compound wall/retaining wall/CC road
Key technical personnel for supervision and execution with qualifications and experience
Unconditional tender undertaking (Annexure III); tender acceptance letter (Annexure II); non-blacklisting affidavit
List of relatives serving in Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways or DGLL
notes: Section I NIT only; no BOQ. Hindi text layer garbled but English values legible. Bid download/submission 09.09.2022 10:00 to 22.09.2022 15:00. Listing gives no bid opening date; NIT says 26.09.2022 15:00.
